item.description:
Timbre 0.2.1

Sounds arrive sooner, and volume follows your hand.

  • The first idea for a sound now lands in a few seconds; the rest fill in behind it while you play.
  • The dots show all six places from the start, so nothing moves as ideas arrive, and you can flip through them straight away.
  • Dragging a sound's level is now smooth, with no lag in Live.
